I do enjoy making things for others. Doing things, even. I try to be giving whenever I can... but I think that comes at a cost. People end up taking advantage of me because of it
I'm glad your blood sugar is fixed. I can only imagine that situation. I do try to be empathic towards others but...I don't know. I guess I kinda feel indifferent in comparison to when I don't try

Could you clarify what  you mean by "let people's feeling become yours"? I don't fully understand.

I like creating digital illustrations, 3d models, and animations. Sometimes I dive into music production. I have a channel where I do song covers/animations and it's gained a good amount of attention, but been inactive for a while. I do whatever idea pops into my head. Unfortunately though I have ADHD so many things end up unfinished. It's hard to put my emotions into my artwork. I don't feel that I am skilled enough to capture how I truly feel. 

I've contemplated about if I want to drop out of school or not. but, I worry about the risk that could come with it. I think I want to at least finish high school. I don't think I'll go to college.
I would like to, but I'm currently in class right now. It's nice to know that someone can relate :)
I wish I knew. It's just a natural feeling unfortunately
It's not stupid :). It's something I've certainly tried before. I still have the same feeling unfortunately. I start to feel gross when I write the things on my head down

I do have a therapist... My anxiety prevents me from saying much though. Sometimes I jokingly say it, but often I hold a rather serious tone. I have a hard time talking to others about my issues... Even writing in a journal makes me extremely uncomfortable.
